verdict.rationale: Bolna's security docs say Indian data residency is available for deployments that must keep data in India. Its enterprise docs also describe self-hosting on your own servers via Docker or Kubernetes, which puts storage location under the customer's control. However, only one residency region is named, and nothing shows how a user selects a region or which regions exist beyond India. Missing for 10: a documented multi-region selection option (e.g., EU/US), how residency is configured or chosen per account or workspace, details of which data categories (recordings, transcripts) stay in-region, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)

citations.quote: Indian data residency is available for deployments where data must remain in India.
Learn how to self-host Bolna Voice AI on your own servers using Docker or Kubernetes for secure, private, and scalable enterprise deployments.
